overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by holding a separate 6:00 PM meeting on April 7 without posted notice, rejecting the recess argument and the reliance on Town Counsel advice, and ordered compliance and release of that meeting's executive session minutes.

allegations.summary: A 6:00 PM continuation of an April 7 morning meeting, including an executive session, was held without posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: Finally, only those actually present at the 10:00 AM meeting received notice of the 6:00 PM meeting, and thus the general public was unaware of the later meeting.

allegations.summary: The executive session held at the unnoticed 6:00 PM meeting was not properly convened, so its minutes were ordered released.
allegations.key_passage: Since the executive session held at 6:00 PM was not properly convened, we order the Committee to release the executive session minutes for that meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
Release the executive session minutes for the meeting held at 6:00 PM on April 7
remedy_passage: In addition, we order the Committee to release the executive session minutes for the meeting held at 6:00 PM on April 7.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
